_note: Hand-added directory listings for businesses that are not Chamber members (or to override a Chamber listing with the same name). Facts only, as the business publishes them; no private individuals' names. Fields: name (required), sections (array of section ids from directory.json, e.g. ["home"]), kinds (e.g. ["Plumbing"]), location, phone, website, about, source (where you verified it). After editing, run `npm run refresh:directory -- --manual-only`.
